theme: Peak summer demand - rooms filling before the early-July rush
season: Peak summer (late June) - Pahalgam and Sonamarg in the high teens to low twenties, Srinagar warm by day and cool at dusk, every pass and the new Z-Morh tunnel open, rivers running cold and full - the calm window before the early-July Amarnath rush fills the south.
subject: A mountain stay was booked this morning, not yours
